I of course refer to our middle distance hammer and discus throwing hurdler - John Coy. Well done all of you, we look forward to another exciting season in 1986.

It is no secret that our youth team in this competition has consisted of John Coy and one or two others. John seems to have made in his personal goal to get the youth team into the final and he has done it!!

Unfortunately some of our talented athletes have been unable to attend on many occasions for various legitimate reasons and this is where our weakness lies Baba and Nadu Khan, Dan Winson, John Coy (Team Captain) and Michael Bowers competed in every match and I would like to thank them for their unswerving loyalty.
They were: Bob Bridges, John and Leo Coy, Tony Ganio, Selami Simsek and Martin Milner. Also Chris Bentley who did an enormous amount of work with the sprint relay squads.
